interpretation: Original summaries of commit-pinned public journals. Source claims are not current execution evidence.

records.summary: An earlier status describes metadata discovery and a planned sampling-policy revision. It is not the accepted panel receipt or a live tree.
The accepted Stage 1 journal reports 177 assemblies across ten operational groups, with Enterococcus excluded. This establishes a sampling frame only; R-M presence and activity are not established.

The independent review reports synthetic inventory regressions for protein parsing, duplicate rejection, unrequested assemblies and input-bound receipts. It explicitly leaves live Datasets, host-marker and DefenseFinder jobs untested.

The parent receipt reports a previous atlas artifact and earlier checks, with browser-navigation limitations. Those claims neither test this implementation nor certify a hosted/native Site or a live scientific pipeline.
